new_agent_start.rule: Read AGENT_START_HERE.md first. You are one parallel agent, not the sole project owner. Do not claim or modify an occupied lane unless explicitly assigned.
resume_order: the assigned lane manifest and only relevant files/evidence
new_agent_start.branch_rule: For a new independent task, create a fresh branch from current main named agent/<short-lane-id>. Use agent/metadata only if it is still free when you begin.
new_agent_start.output_rule: Keep experimental Surveyor changes lane-specific while unfinished. Once a change is complete, validated, documented, and recoverable, publish it directly to main without waiting for a separate integration-agent merge or user approval. Update lane status/manifest, extension index and hashes when applicable, WORKSPACE_STATE.json, and AI_HANDOFF.md. A PR is optional or a fallback if direct push is unavailable. Preserve a backup branch or exact base commit and rollback steps.
new_agent_start.autonomy_rule: Keep working until human intervention is genuinely required. For every identified next step, first determine whether it can be done with repository files, code, available tools, or existing evidence; execute it if possible instead of merely reporting it. Diagnose failed attempts and try reasonable alternatives. After completing the objective, choose the next highest-value useful lane task. Ask the user only for a true human-only dependency; finish independent work first and provide one exact numbered recipe. If another lane blocks progress, continue independent work and prepare a concrete handoff instead of idling.

artifact_policy.github_role: manifests, patches, evidence, branches, PRs, source-state summaries

cross_mode_rule: Normal ChatGPT and Work/Codex must treat committed GitHub state as authoritative and may switch roles without relying on hidden conversation context.
